svg.title: What you can ask Improvado MCP: six example questions, not sample results
svg.desc: Example questions for Improvado MCP: Compare ad spend by channel for the last 30 days. Which campaigns had the highest cost per conversion last week? Compare ROAS across Google Ads, Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads this month. Show sessions and conversions by source in GA4 for the last 14 days. Did any channel's spend change sharply compared with the previous week? Build a weekly performance summary I can share with my team. These are example questions, not sample results.
